behavioral_effects: MCP server tools (docling, chrome-devtools, github, huggingface, context7, user connections) are defer-loaded: the default request drops from ~124 tool schemas (~163KB JSON, ~40k input tokens) to the core agent tools plus one search_tools entry

Every OpenRouter request opts into prompt caching for tool definitions, system instructions, and message history (5m TTL); Logfire previously showed zero cache reads at ~30-46k full-price input tokens per call
compatibility_impact: Model-facing request shape changes: MCP tool schemas leave the default request and a search_tools function tool appears; the model must discover MCP tools before calling them (one extra round-trip on first use per run). OpenRouter requests now carry cache_control breakpoints; ignored by downstream providers without explicit cache support. No HTTP contract, WebSocket event, or schema changes.
follow_up: Verify realized token reduction and cache_read_tokens in Logfire after the next few live chat turns
limitations: Google Workspace tools keep their existing loadout gating rather than moving to tool search; the two mechanisms coexist
Per-turn MCP liveness probes (tools/list round-trip per server per turn) are a latency cost this change does not address
reason: Logfire shows ~30-46k input tokens per model call with 104 of 124 tool schemas (~163KB JSON) attached to every request and zero cache reads; deferring MCP tool schemas behind pydantic-ai tool search and enabling OpenRouter cache_control cuts the per-request payload and re-bills the stable prefix at cache-read rates
risks: Tool-discovery quality depends on keyword overlap between the model's search query and MCP tool names/descriptions; a turn that needs an obscurely named tool may need a second search
Conversation history is rebuilt from PostgreSQL as plain text, so discovered-tool state does not persist across turns; each new turn that needs MCP tools pays one search round-trip again
rollback: git revert of the single commit restores full-catalog tool attachment and uncached requests; no data, schema, or config migration involved
security_impact: None new. Tool exposure narrows rather than widens: MCP tool schemas are hidden from the model until discovered via pydantic-ai tool search, while the GitHub read-only probe-time guard, per-connection allowlist filtering (applied before deferral), and credential resolution are untouched. search_tools reveals only names/descriptions of tools the user's own connections already expose. The three standing MCP findings are unaffected.
summary: Reduce agent token consumption via deferred MCP tool loading and OpenRouter prompt caching
